title.suggested: Policeman C. W. Price was once Allen's barkeeper

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that policeman C. W. Price, who brought charges against Harrigan, came to America with Tom Allen and had been the barkeeper at Allen's old Washington Avenue free-and-easy.

metadata.notes: No page image to check the masthead. The source file name gives Saturday, May 30, 1885, St. Louis Post-Dispatch.

facts.fact: C. W. Price, an Englishman, came to America with Allen and was for some time his protégé in St. Louis
Price was the barkeeper at the old Washington Avenue free-and-easy that Allen kept in his prime, a place known for the thugs and roughs who frequented it

notes: Price joined the police in 1877. The free-and-easy is probably the one at 417 Washington Ave (facts 009/017), but the article gives no address.
